sections.text: The rule that shaped this list: he has to dress himself. No button flies, no belts, no back zippers — pull-on elastic waists only.

sections.title: Bottoms — 4
sections.blurb: The fleece joggers are the deliberate duplicate — they are what he reaches for daily, so buy two colours rather than washing one pair constantly.

sections.title: Three outfits this makes
sections.body:
1. Rainy Tuesday — long-sleeve tee + fleece joggers + water-resistant shell
2. Picture day — oxford shirt + barrel pants
3. Cold playground — tee + sweatshirt + shell over joggers

sections.text: ⚠ Measure his feet before ordering any shoes. Stand him barefoot against a wall, mark the longest toe, measure heel-to-mark: 16.9 cm = 10.5C · 17.3 cm = 11C · 17.6 cm = 11.5C · 17.9 cm = 12C.
